input: Retained reconstructed case 4 state at obstacle appearance, 2026-10-14

assumptions.plant: circular target with nonlinear inverse-square Earth gravity; stationary RTN obstacle

method: For any acceleration with norm <= A, distance from the stationary obstacle at tau is <= norm(r0-c+v0*tau)+A*tau^2/2. A first-exit bootstrap keeps the position and speed within the bounds used to derive A for the entire interval.
limits: Model-conditional analytic reachability bound, not a new collision-avoidance controller or general flight certification.
The original failing scenario remains a failure and stays in success-rate denominators.
No change to appearance time, limits, control rate or policy is authorized by this calculation.
provenance: New reconstruction and model-conditional calculation; not original paper data.
